text: 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. CON 2d10 radiant. Shapechangers have disadvantage.

name: Move Earth
text: Reshape dirt, sand, or clay in a 40-foot cube every 10 minutes. Not stone.

name: Nondetection
text: Hidden from divination magic.

name: Pass without Trace
text: You and allies in 30 feet +10 Stealth. No tracks.

name: Passwall
text: A 5×8×20-foot passage through wood, plaster, or stone.

name: Phantasmal Killer
text: WIS save or frightened. WIS 4d10 psychic each turn.

name: Phantom Steed
text: A quasi-real horse, 100 feet speed. Ritual.

name: Planar Ally
text: A celestial, elemental, or fiend appears. Bargain for service.

name: Planar Binding
text: CHA save. Bind a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend to service.

name: Plane Shift
text: You and 8 willing, or banish one CHA save with a melee spell attack.

name: Plant Growth
text: Overgrowth: 4× movement in 100 feet. Or enrich land for a year.

name: Poison Spray
text: CON save or 1d12 poison.

name: Polymorph
text: WIS save. A creature becomes a beast of CR equal to its level or CR.

name: Power Word Kill
text: If 100 HP or fewer, it dies.

name: Power Word Stun
text: If 150 HP or fewer, stunned. CON save at end of turns.

name: Prayer of Healing
text: Up to 6 creatures 2d8 + modifier HP.

name: Prestidigitation
text: Tiny tricks: spark, clean, flavor, mark, a trinket.

name: Prismatic Spray
text: d8 for each creature: fire, acid, lightning, poison, cold, restrained, or two rays.

name: Prismatic Wall
text: Seven layers: red fire, orange acid, yellow lightning, green poison, blue cold, indigo restrained/petrify, violet blinded/plane shift.

name: Private Sanctum
text: Mordenkainen's. Ward a cube vs scrying, teleport, sound, vision, planar travel.

name: Produce Flame
text: A flame in your hand. 10 bright / 10 dim. Hurl for 1d8 fire.

name: Programmed Illusion
text: A 30-foot cube scripted illusion that triggers on a condition.

name: Project Image
text: An illusory copy. See and hear through it. Appear to speak.

name: Protection from Energy
text: Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
text: Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead: disadvantage to hit you. You can't be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them.

name: Protection from Poison
text: Neutralize one poison. Advantage on saves vs poison. Resistance to poison damage.

name: Purify Food and Drink
text: Render food and drink in a 5-foot-radius sphere pure. Ritual.

name: Raise Dead
text: Return a creature dead no more than 10 days. −4 to rolls, lessens by 1 per long rest.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
text: Half damage from STR weapons. CON save at end of turns.

name: Ray of Frost
text: 1d8 cold. Speed −10 feet until your next turn.

name: Regenerate
text: 4d8+15 HP now, 1 HP per turn. Restore severed parts in 2 minutes.

name: Reincarnate
text: A new adult body, random humanoid race, for a soul dead no more than 10 days.

name: Remove Curse
text: End all curses on a creature or object. Cursed items can be dropped.

name: Resilient Sphere
text: Otiluke's. A Large or smaller creature in a sphere of force. DEX save.

name: Resistance
text: Once, add 1d4 to a save.

name: Resurrection
text: A creature dead up to a century, not of old age. −4 penalty. You gain a long-rest penalty too if the creature was dead a year.

name: Reverse Gravity
text: 50-radius, 100-high cylinder. DEX to grab something. Fall upward.

name: Revivify
text: Return a creature dead no more than 1 minute to 1 HP.

name: Rope Trick
text: A rope leads to an extradimensional hideout for 8 Medium creatures.

name: Sacred Flame
text: DEX save or 1d8 radiant. No cover.

name: Sanctuary
text: WIS save to attack the warded creature. Ends if it attacks or casts a spell that affects an enemy.

name: Scorching Ray
text: Three rays, 2d6 fire each.

name: Scrying
text: A sensor follows a creature. WIS save, DC modified by knowledge and connection.

name: Secret Chest
text: Leomund's. Hide a chest on the Ethereal. Retrieve it.

name: See Invisibility
text: See invisible and into the Ethereal Plane.

name: Seeming
text: Disguise any number of creatures you can see. CHA save if unwilling.

name: Sending
text: 25 words to a creature you know, any distance, any plane (5% miss other planes).

name: Sequester
text: Hide a willing creature or object from every sense and divination. Time stops for a creature.

name: Shapechange
text: Become any creature CR/level equal or lower. Keep personality and INT/WIS/CHA. Change again with an action.

name: Shatter
text: 10-foot-radius sphere. CON 3d8 thunder. Constructs disadvantage. Nonmagical objects take the damage.

name: Shield
text: +5 AC until your next turn. Magic missile misses you.

name: Shield of Faith
text: +2 AC.

name: Shillelagh
text: Club or quarterstaff uses your spellcasting ability and deals 1d8 magic bludgeoning.

name: Shocking Grasp
text: 1d8 lightning. Advantage if metal armor. No reactions until its next turn.

name: Silence
text: 20-foot-radius sphere of silence. No thunder, no verbal components. Ritual.

name: Silent Image
text: A 15-foot cube image. Investigation vs your DC.

name: Simulacrum
text: An ice-and-snow copy of a beast or humanoid. Half HP. No slots recover. One at a time.

name: Sleep
text: 5d8 HP of creatures fall unconscious, lowest first. No undead or immune-to-charm.

name: Sleet Storm
text: 20-radius, 40-high. Heavily obscured, difficult, DEX or prone, CON to keep concentration.

name: Slow
text: Up to 6 in a 40-foot cube. WIS save. Speed halved, −2 AC, no reactions, one action not both, delayed spells.

name: Spare the Dying
text: A living creature at 0 HP becomes stable.

name: Speak with Animals
text: Talk to beasts. Ritual.

name: Speak with Dead
text: Five questions to a corpse. It must still have a mouth. No compulsion to tell truth.

name: Speak with Plants
text: Talk to plants. Turn difficult plant terrain into ordinary, or the reverse.

name: Spider Climb
text: Climb speed equal to walking. Walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Spike Growth
text: 20-foot-radius difficult terrain. 2d4 piercing per 5 feet moved.

name: Spirit Guardians
text: Spirits. Slow enemies. WIS 3d8 radiant or necrotic when they enter or start there.

name: Spiritual Weapon
text: A spectral weapon. 1d8 + modifier force. Bonus action to move 20 and attack again.

name: Stinking Cloud
text: 20-foot-radius heavily obscured. CON or spend the turn retching.

name: Stone Shape
text: Form a 5-foot cube of stone. A door, a trap, a statue.

name: Stoneskin
text: Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

name: Storm of Vengeance
text: A 360-foot-radius storm. Round by round: acid, lightning, hail, then 2d6 bludgeoning and 1d6 acid, deafened, difficult terrain.

name: Suggestion
text: WIS save. A reasonable course of action, up to a sentence or two.

name: Sunbeam
text: CON 6d8 radiant and blinded. Undead and oozes disadvantage. Action again each turn.

name: Sunburst
text: 60-radius. CON 12d6 radiant and blinded. Undead and oozes disadvantage. Dispels darkness of 8th or lower.

name: Symbol
text: A glyph: death, discord, fear, hopelessness, insanity, pain, sleep, or stunning.

name: Telekinesis
text: Move a creature (STR vs yours) or an object up to 1,000 lb.

name: Telepathic Bond
text: Rary's. Up to 8 willing creatures share telepathy. Ritual.

name: Telepathy
text: A link with one willing creature. Any distance, any plane.

name: Teleport
text: You and 8 others, or one object. Mishap table by familiarity.

name: Teleportation Circle
text: A circle linked to a permanent circle you know the sigils of.

name: Thaumaturgy
text: Voice booms, flames flicker, tremors, doors slam, your eyes change.

name: Thorn Whip
text: 1d6 piercing. Pull a Large or smaller creature 10 feet closer.

name: Thunderwave
text: CON save, 2d8 thunder, pushed 10 feet. Half damage on a save.

name: Time Stop
text: 1d4+1 extra turns. Ends if you affect another creature or an object they wear.

name: Tiny Hut
text: Leomund's. A dome for 9 Medium. Ritual. Comfortable. You can leave and return.

name: Tongues
text: Understand any language. Any creature that knows a language understands you.

name: Transport via Plants
text: Step into a Large plant, out of another on the same plane that you have seen.

name: Tree Stride
text: Step into a tree and out of another of the same kind within 500 feet.

name: True Polymorph
text: WIS save. Creature into creature, creature into object, or object into creature. Permanent if concentrated the hour.

name: True Resurrection
text: Restore a creature dead up to 200 years, even without a body, if the soul is free.

name: True Seeing
text: Truesight 120 feet. See into the Ethereal.

name: True Strike
text: Advantage on your first attack against the target next turn.

name: Unseen Servant
text: An invisible Medium force. 2 HP, STR 2. Fetches and cleans. Ritual.

name: Vampiric Touch
text: 3d6 necrotic melee, you gain half. Attack again each turn.

name: Vicious Mockery
text: WIS save or 1d4 psychic and disadvantage on its next attack.

name: Wall of Fire
text: A wall 60×20×1 or a ring. DEX 5d8 fire. Damage when entering or ending there.

name: Wall of Force
text: A wall or hemisphere of force. Immune to almost everything. Disintegrate destroys it.

name: Wall of Ice
text: Ten 10×10×1-foot panels. DEX 10d6 cold if spawned on a creature. 12 AC, 30 HP per 10-foot section.

name: Wall of Stone
text: Ten 10×10×6-inch panels. Can become permanent.

name: Wall of Thorns
text: DEX 7d8 piercing. 4× movement. DEX each 5 feet moved.

name: Warding Bond
text: Target +1 AC, +1 saves, resistance to all damage. You take the same damage.

name: Water Breathing
text: Up to 10 creatures. Ritual.

name: Water Walk
text: Up to 10 creatures walk on liquid. Ritual.

name: Web
text: 20-foot cube of webs. DEX save or restrained. DC 12 STR. Flammable.

name: Weird
text: 30-radius. WIS save or frightened. WIS 4d10 psychic each turn.

name: Wind Walk
text: You and 10 others become clouds. Fly 300 feet. 1 minute to shift forms.

name: Wind Wall
text: 50×15×1 feet of wind. Small missiles fail. Gases blocked. STR save or pushed.

name: Wish
text: Duplicate an 8th-or-lower spell with no components, or a free-form wish. Stress: 33% chance you can never cast it again.

name: Word of Recall
text: You and 5 allies teleport to a sanctuary you prepared.

name: Zone of Truth
text: 15-foot-radius. CHA save or cannot lie.
